histogram.claim: Processes inputs below 8,192 bytes in order and delegates inputs at or above 8,192 bytes to the four-quarter loop. Adds byte frequencies modulo 65,536 across the first 256 uint16 counters and preserves the remaining backing. Capacity under 256 panics before any write, even with empty input.
histogram.limits: Ordinary disjoint Go byte input and uint16 backing, with any valid histogram slice length and capacity. The model stores the backing from the slice start through capacity and abstracts away initial length because reslicing uses available capacity. The observable panic outcome is modeled without the runtime panic payload. Lean proves the short-capacity branch leaves the complete backing unchanged. Traversal/counting agreement is differential.
histogram.configurations: Pinned native Go via direct same-package overlay, compiled Lean, and independent frequency-count oracle. 443 fixed rows include all four remainders around 8,192 bytes, bin updates spanning multiple uint16 wraps, capacity 255/256, nil and zero-length inputs, and full-backing tail sentinels. 60,000 sampled rows use seeds 17, 2718 and 65537.

histogramSplit.claim: Consumes the length remainder first and then interleaves four equal contiguous quarters, incrementing each selected counter even when lanes select the same bin. histogramSplit.limits: Ordinary disjoint Go byte input and uint16 backing, with any valid histogram slice length and capacity.
